intro: Adept is a student project for exploring future skills and planning learning. Use the published sample CVs for demonstrations.
scope: Adept suggests roles and learning routes. You choose your target and confirm your skills. Employers and institutions retain all hiring, promotion and admission decisions.
estimates: Match scores, outlooks, time and cost estimates support planning. They do not guarantee employment, qualification, course availability or funding. Check the dated sources and the provider’s current terms before enrolling.
data: Use synthetic profiles and public reference data for this demonstration. Keep your account secure and do not upload another person’s information. Skill sharing with an organisation is optional; accepting a programme requires its stated agreement. See Privacy for storage, providers and your account rights.
conduct: Do not attempt to access another workspace, submit harmful files or misuse the service. Report problems through the project’s GitHub issues without posting personal information or credentials.
faqIntro: Start with the short answers below. Open Data & AI use for methods, sources and model details.
